notes: IFRS, fiscal year ended March 31, 2026 (SBG's 'FY2025'). Formula applied as-is; treat with caution, it is not like-for-like with operating companies. (1) Revenue is mostly the telecom and internet business (SoftBank Corp. / LY Corp.) and Arm; the SoftBank Vision Funds and the Investment Business of Holding Companies book their results as gains on investments below net sales, and their buying and selling of investments sits in investing (e.g. SVF acquisitions 5,106,118, including ¥5,081,443 million invested in OpenAI by SVF2), so the investment arms barely enter paidOut except through their operating costs and the holding company's interest. (2) Operating cash flow was negative (−428,832), which pushes paidOut above revenue; interest paid (839,234, up from 482,111) and income taxes paid (821,620, of which ¥461,214 million was paid by SBG itself, mainly on fiscal 2024 taxable income from settling prepaid forward contracts with Alibaba shares, plus interim payments, per the integrated report's MD&A) are inside OCF and so already in paidOut via revenue − OCF; much of the interest is holding-company interest on debt that funds investments, not on the operating business. (3) Asset-management subsidiaries' securities flows inside OCF net to −219,084 (flag investmentPurchasesInOCF). (4) Banking and card finance flows of PayPay Bank / PayPay Card presumably sit in OCF but are not separately disclosed (flag financeReceivablesInOCF, amount null). (5) Net sales include ¥251,546 million of revenue from sources other than IFRS 15, such as lease contracts in the Enterprise business and finance transactions in the Financial business. Taxes paid are gross of 37,322 refunds; both in OCF. Lease principal (192,823) noted, not added.
